mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized at approximately -22% over the past four weeks with a slight upward trend from -23.7% to -21.9%. This stabilization signals market equilibrium in suppressed retail demand. Absent a shock, this equilibrium persists, producing flat or marginally positive RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines by more than 2 percentage points in any single week over the next four weeks, or falls below -23% in mean over the 28-day forward window.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has collapsed from 28.3% (t-3w) to 3.0% (t-1w), indicating seasonal shift away from outdoor recreation. This behavioral reallocation redirects leisure time toward indoor retail and recreation venues, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks as autumn weather deteriorates further.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 5% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined 90% from t-3w to t-1w
failure_condition: PARKS mobility rebounds above 10% in any week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT stations remain severely depressed at -32.9%, indicating continued restrictions or behavioral avoidance of public transport. If TRANSIT remains below -30% for the next four weeks, retail venues dependent on transit-accessible footfall will remain suppressed, keeping RETAIL_REC negative and flat.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -30% for all four weeks ahead
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -32.9% (t-0w), stable over four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility rises above -25% in any week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 3 percentage points relative to the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has stabilized near -31% over four weeks. Coupled with RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated at 7.1%, this signals persistent remote work and home-based activity. The combination suppresses commuting-driven retail visits and sustains depressed RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES below -30% AND RESIDENTIAL above 6% simultaneously
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -25% or RESIDENTIAL falls below 5% in any week, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 percentage points relative to the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has declined steadily from -1.7% to -3.6% to -3.0%, indicating reduced essential shopping frequency. This contraction signals either supply-chain efficiency gains or behavioral consolidation of shopping trips. Reduced shopping trip frequency suppresses incidental retail visits, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -3% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declined from -1.7% to -3.6% over three weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rebounds above -1% in any week, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 1 percentage point relative to the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS collapse (28.3% to 3.0%) combined with TRANSIT depression (-32.9%) creates a dual constraint: outdoor leisure is seasonally unavailable and transit-dependent retail access is restricted. This dual suppression forces retail demand to remain depressed as consumers lack both motivation and means to visit retail venues over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS below 5% AND TRANSIT below -30% simultaneously for two weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at 12.1% (t-0w) but declining trend; TRANSIT at -32.9%
failure_condition: Either PARKS rises above 15% or TRANSIT rises above -25% in any week, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 percentage points relative to the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC shows marginal improvement from -23.7% to -21.9% over two weeks. If this upward momentum continues at the observed rate of approximately +1 percentage point per week, RETAIL_REC will reach -18% to -17% over the next four weeks, producing a positive direction signal relative to the prior 28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC improves by at least 0.5 percentage points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 1.8 percentage points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in any week over the next four weeks, or the mean over the 28-day forward window is lower than the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES remains severely depressed at -30.3% while GROCERY_PHARM shows slight deterioration to -3.0%. This combination signals ongoing workplace restrictions and cautious consumer behavior. If both remain in this regime, RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed as workplace-based social activity and associated retail visits are constrained over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES below -30% AND GROCERY_PHARM below -2.5% simultaneously
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -25% or GROCERY_PHARM rises above -1% in any week, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 1 percentage point relative to the prior 28-day mean.
